description: Buying a home against renting and investing the difference, over a number of years: when buying pulls ahead, if it does. Use for 'are we better off buying at £350k or renting at £1,400 a month'.

annualHousePriceGrowthPct.description: House price growth a year. Defaults to 3.

annualInvestmentReturnPct.description: What the renter's invested money earns a year. Defaults to 5.

annualMaintenancePct.description: Maintenance a year as a share of the price. Defaults to 1.

annualRentInflationPct.description: Rent rises a year. Defaults to 3.

buyingCosts.description: Stamp duty and other one-off costs. Defaults to stamp duty at standard rates plus £2,000.

monthlyRent.description: Rent a month for the alternative, in pounds.

mortgageTermYears.description: Mortgage term in years. Defaults to 25.

sellingCostsPct.description: Selling costs as a share of the sale price. Defaults to 2.

years.description: Years to compare over. Defaults to 10.

name: calculate_rent_vs_buy
title: Rent vs buy
